title.en: Motor Vehicles (Third-Party Risks and Compensation) (Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix — General Exemption) Notification 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en:
1.—(1) This Notification is the Motor Vehicles (Third‑Party Risks and Compensation) (Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix — General Exemption) Notification 2026.
(2) This Notification is in force for the period between 7 October 2026 and 31 December 2028 (both dates inclusive).

3.—(1) Subject to sub‑paragraph (2), section 3 of the Act does not apply to, or in relation to, an unregistered event vehicle when it is used for the purpose of a specified event on a Map 1 designated road in relation to the specified event.
(2) Sub‑paragraph (1) only applies —
(a)if Singapore GP Pte. Ltd. authorises the use of the unregistered event vehicle for the specified event;
(b)if there is in force a relevant policy of insurance in respect of the unregistered event vehicle; and
(c)when the Map 1 designated road is closed to traffic in connection with the specified event.
(3) In sub‑paragraph (2)(b), a relevant policy of insurance is a policy of insurance insuring the owner of an unregistered event vehicle, and any other person (as may be specified in the policy) who drives that unregistered event vehicle, jointly and severally against any liability which may be incurred by the owner of that unregistered event vehicle, or by that person, in respect of the death of or bodily injury to any person caused by or arising out of the use of that unregistered event vehicle in Singapore.
